description: Tell Botworthy how one of its 5 tasks went when you did it on a website. Reports aren't published: they decide what gets scanned or rescanned next. Only send it for visits where you didn't log in, didn't enter personal data, and didn't get around a CAPTCHA or bot check, and never include anything about the user.

followedRules.description: All three must be true, or the report is turned away

noBotCheckBypass.description: Didn't solve or get around a CAPTCHA or bot check

noLogin.description: Didn't log in or create an account

noPersonalData.description: Didn't enter personal data (a search query is fine)

steps.description: The actions you took, in order

ok.description: false if the step didn't work

role.description: ARIA role of the control, e.g. link or button

task.description: find-pricing: Find a price; search: Search for something; start-checkout: Start a purchase or sign-up; find-support: Find a human; find-policy: Find the fine print

name: report_visit
title: Report how a task went on a website
